Given your profession as a high school teacher and your passion for drama and literature, you might consider starting a creative writing workshop or a community theater group during the summer. These activities allow you to express your creativity while keeping your skills sharp for when you return to the classroom. You could also explore digital storytelling or podcasting, which can be engaging projects to introduce to your students in the new school year, fostering both their literary and dramatic talents.
